# TX / FG: Textures and Colors in Strings

Source: [6560](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/6560); edited 2025-08-07. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-6560-n1"></a>

- Documents sanitization-bypass setup exploiting 127-byte dummy-name truncation to obtain an escaped less-than character.

<a id="wiki-6560-n2"></a>

- Texture tags encode a 16-hex-digit identifier; foreground tags encode RRGGBBAA.

<a id="wiki-6560-n3"></a>

- Article explicitly reports bypass unpatched as of August 8 2025, and a different Season 17 sanitization bug patched August 5 2025.
